balls.text: top-edges a reverse paddle shot! Low full toss around off stump, he tries to reverse it and the ball flies off the back of the bat to fine-leg boundary
yorker length outside off, Badri presses back and tries to squeeze out a square drive but makes no contact
What a shot! Reverse paddle sweep! He crouched and reversed it through vacant slip region
Hussey's struggles continue. Swing and miss. The ball rolls of the pad
slower one, dragged to deep square-leg
dropped by Tiwary at deep midwicket. It was swung straight to him and he makes a right royal mess of it.
pushes it full  down the leg side and Badri paddles it away yet again ...
fullish, forced down to long-on
plays another paddle sweep but this time there is a fine-leg in place
hit back down the track and it crashes against the stump at the non-striker's end .. Malinga rushes back, and uproots one stump but by then Hussey was back
Finally, they try something. Badri walks outside off and plays a fine paddle scoop!
low full toss, pushed away to long-on.
just another single .... down to long-on
fullish, on the middle stump line, lifted to long-on
yet another slower one, pushed out past point
slower one, outside off stump, squeezed out to Tendulkar at short third man
yorker length, edged away to the off side
fullish on the middle stump line, driven for a single
drops it on the blockhole, just about dug out by Hussey
pushed out to midwicket for a quick signle .. had it been a direct hit from Pollard, Badri would have been run out
high full toss, swatted away back to Harbhajan who "catches" it. He immediately apologies and the umpire calls it a no ball
backs away slightly to drive to left of long-off ..and they rush back to beat the throw from Bravo
full again, driven to long-off ... just another single
really full delivery, eased to long-on
goes down on his knee to sweep it to deep midwicket
slow dipping full delivery, pushed out to long-off
full pitched on the middle, worked away to Bravo at deep midwicket
from round the stumps, eased to long-on
walks down the track and towards off and flicks the full delivery through midwicket
length delivery outside off, defended on the front foot.
slower one outside off, tries to run it to third man, edges it and the ball rolls to Rayudu
on the middle and leg, turned to long leg
slower one, eased to long-off
full pitched, pushed back to the bowler
leans forward to push it to backward point
on the off and middle, eased behind square-leg ..
full in length outside off, around 114 kmph, pushed back to the bowler
No Mongoose bumps this time. Full delivery on the middle and off line, slower one, Hayden lifts it straight to long-on.
Done in by the slow bouncer. Around 106 kmph short ball. Dhoni was made to wait and he couldn't time his pull shot well. The ball lobs straight up on the on side.
reaches out to flat-bat a slower short-of-length delivery to left of long-off
mistimes another attempted hit .. just a single to deep midwicket region
another slower one, well outside off stump, dips .. dragged to the on side ..towardsmid-on ..Dhponi wants a second run but Hayden sends him back
slower one outside off stump, Dhoni goes for the big swing to the cowcorner and ends up dragging it to right of deep midwicket fielder
very full delivery, on the leg and middle, Dhoni tries to squeeze it to the on side and gets a leading edge. Good over this. Fast and full.
low dipping full toss, around 143 kmph, pushed out to long-off
slips a wide outside off stump .. around 145 kmph
another really full delivery, pushed down to long-on
not quite an yorker but pretty full, pushed out to Tendulkar at short midwicket
fires it full again, around 140 kmph, Hayden mistimes the attempted big hit to mid-on
full delivery, around 139 kmph around off, Dhoni goes for the big drive and edges it to cover point
jumps down the track and on drives to long-on
Edged to right Rayudu. It was the lifting delivery outside off, Dhoni was surprised by the bounce and stabs it clear of the leaping Rayudu
from round the stumps, full and outside off,d ragged down to long-on.
slower one outside off, jabbed out to cover
works this one past midwicket
walks down the track and dabs the slower one to short third man
low full toss surprises Hayden who just pushes it tamely to cover
steps forward to whack the short-of-length delivery to right of long-on where Harbhajan makes a fine tumbling stop this time
flicks this one past square-leg for couple of runs
steps forward to on drive to right of long-on where Harbhajan should have stopped it but doesn't. He slid to his right and tried to push it back to the field of play ..
fullish, on the middle stump line, worked through midwicket
leans forward to drive to sweeper cover
length delivery on the middle and off line, punched to long-on
fullish on the middle and leg, flicked away to deep midwicket region
Again on the legs, Dhoni glances it to the fine-leg boundary
Dhoni stays back to clip the length delivery to left of Bravo at deep backward square-leg
length delivery cutting in to the middle and leg, Dhoni calmly works it past short fine-leg fielder
leans forward to drive to long-off
pushes it well outside off stump. Wide
pushed out to the on side for a single
Done in by the short ball. Again. Raina goes for the pull but he mistimes it .. sort of carves it to Shikhar Dhawan, who runs in from deep midwicket to take it
short and wide, Raina goes for the cut but flashes his bat under the ball
Wallop! The Raina heave over midwicket. He clears the front foot and swings the slower one over midwicket
yorker on the middle stump, squeezed out to cover
short in length outside off stump, forced down  to long-on
well outside off stump, Harper extends his arms
length delivery on the middle stump line, pushed out towards midwicket for a quick single
fullish, turned to backward square-leg
on the middle and leg line, swung away to Tiwary at deep square-leg
full and down the leg side, Rayudu collects
length delivery outside off, flat-batted to long-off
short in length, angling away from Raina who dabs it to left of third man where Bravo makes a fine stop and releases the ball on the run
fullish, on the middle, driven to left of short cover where Nachim makes a tumbling stop
swing and a miss. In the zone outside off, Raina can't get bat to ball
Edged away. 138.4 kmph fullish delivery outside off stump, Raina stays where he is and pushes out it. He gets a thick edge and the ball flies through the vacant slip region.
142.1 kmph length delivery well outside off .. Raina lets it go .. Harper says not wide enough
driven down to Tiwary at long-off
in the channel outside off, Hayden doesn't connect with his drive
pushed through square of the wicket for a single
around 138 knmph delivery well outside off stump,,, it bounces before Rayudu .. who fails to stop it .. not easy even for regular keepers ..
good ball, turns from the middle towards middle and off, Hayden is late in reacting and just about edges it to point. He sets for a single but is sent back
moves down the track and lifts it one bounce to long-off
dips outside off, pushed back to the bowler
comes down the track and ends up dragging the attempted lofted hit past square-leg.. Harbhajan has been bowling superbly
leans across to slice a flighted delivery outside off over backward point
flighted around off stump, Raina lunges out and almost slices a catch to backward point
sharp bouncer, around 146 kmph snorter, Hayden is surprised and tries to fend it away and the ball flies past his face
leans across to defend

I thought it was a mis-hit but it has sailed over long-on. It was the slower one outside off stump, Hayden leaned forward and at the last moment, decided to sort of flick it on the up. Flick of the wrist and the ball sails over all the way. Incredible.
around 120 kmph again, pushed wide of cover for a single
and another slow one from Malinga, Raina defends it back down the pitch
full, straight and slow, around 120 kmph, jabbed out to the on side

Full in length and outside off stump, Vijay prefers to press back and cut. Perhaps not the length for it. The ball spun in to take the inside edge and went on to hit the stumps. As Matt Prior said, 'Never pat a burning dog and cut an offspinner!"
pushes it down the leg side and Rayudu does well to get his body around in time and stops it
another one almost on the blockhole, pushed out back to the bowler
on the off stump, full in length, Hayden is late in getting forward but eventually does so to ping long-off
really full, almost in the blockhole, dug out back to the bowler
from round the stumps, slower, around off stump line, pusehd out to short straightish cover
moves down the track and pushes it towards long-on for a single ..
outside off stump, run down to third man
around 143 kmph sharp bouncer that flies just down the leg side .. Too fast and too high for Rayudu who jumps but can't hold on
yet another slower one, outside off, tapped to backward point
beaten by the slower one.. Full in length and moving away from Hayden who pushes inside the line. Rayudu doesn't collect cleanly though as it bounces in front of him .. Byes.
around 142 kmph, fullish, on the middle and leg, flicked past square-leg for a single
another slower one, on the middle stump line, defended on the front foot
really full delivery, slower one, around 120 kmph outside off stump, Vijay crouched, waited, opened the bat-face to play a fine square drive
fetches the full length delivery from outside off and sweeps it hard to the deep square-leg boundary. Typical Hayden hit.
really full in length, pushed towards mid-on for a single. Just two runs so far
on the middle and leg, wristed to short fine-leg
turns in from outside off and bounces as well .. Vijay is troubled, stabs out at it and the ball hits the back of the arm and goes past the stumps
on the off and middle, Hayden pushes it to mid-off for a single
full in length, just outside off, Hayden stays back to push it to cover
leans forward to push it towards mid-on
Screamer. Full in length and outside off stump, Vijay stands and delivers: he flays that to left of mid-off. Hayden gets across with words of encouragement
outside off stump, slashed away to third man .. Nachim with the wild throw .. Harbhajan fails to back-up cleanly
short in length, cuts in to the middle and leg, bounces extra and thuds into the thigh pad
stays back to push a length delivery back to the bowler
full in length outside off stump, steered to backward point
The off stump has been pegged back. Full, straight, tilting in from round the stumps, Harbhajan goes for the swing across the line and misses. Timber!
banged in short outside off, Harbhajan goes for the pull but no wood on leather
Delicious thump! He cleared the front foot and smashed the low dipping full toss over long-off
yorker outside off stump, dug out to the off side ..
another full delivery, dragged of the inner edge to backward square-leg  ...
moves towards off, tries to swing it to the on side .. almost yorker length, edged to his pad
low full toss wide outside off stump ... Bollinger thinks its a harsh call.. seems a fair call ..
on the off stump line, hi to Thushara at short cover
presses back and drags it to Hayden at short midwicket
stays back to thump it down to long-on
moves down the track and edges it to fine-leg region
stays back to mishit to the on side ...
moves down the track and slices it to deep point region
yorker length from round the stumps, outside off, Harbhajan can't get bat to ball
moves outside leg and drills the full delivery, from over the stumps, to sweeper cover
full in length, from round the stumps, mishit towards long-on
Violence! low full toss from round the stumps, Harbhajan hammers it over long-on
Twhack! A flat-batted thrash over long-on. He cleared the front leg and slapped the short of length delivery over long-on
fullish, around off, mishit back to Bowler
stays back to force it away to long-off
jabbed out to square-leg for a single
down the leg side  .. wide
goes for the swing but doesn't connect properly

No ball for height. Thushara can't bowl again  around  waist-high full toss, Harbhajan pulls to backward square-leg boundary. Harper has a word with the third ump. Was it over waist? Third ump says it was. Harper forgets that he had already warned Thushara for a beamer before. The square-leg umpire comes across and tells Harper that he had already warned him before. And so Harper has a chat with the bowler and tells him he has to go. He can't bowl again.
And that's it folks. Tendulkar too is gone. He holes out to long-on. What a collapse today after he retired hurt.
length delivery outside off, swats it to midwicket
shuffles across to dab it to the on side for a single
attempts the sweep shot . doesn't connect ..

dropped by the bowler. Tendulkar came down the track and mishit it completely .. Jakati thinks it's flying over him and raises his hands up .. he just didn't see it .. and shuts his eyes ...it was a mishit and the ball actually lobbed gently to hit Jakati on his chest!
moves down the track, again Jakati shortens the length, Tendulkar punches it on the up over the bowler
moves down the track, Jakati shortens the length, HArbhajan pushes his pad in front as he attempts to jab it away
rushes down the track and hammers it to the straight boundary
leans forward to drives to wide long-on region
on the middle and leg, turned behind square-leg
geos down on his knee to sweep to right of short fine-leg
shuffles to the off side and smashes it really hard back at Ashwin who stretches his right hand out and is hit on his wrist. Ouch!
turned to square-leg

What a collapse! Crumbling away! Dhoni and the bowler react as if it was bowled! It landed on the off and middle and straightened to hit the pad in front of off stump. Dhoni runs forward and the bowler rushes forward in celebration. Some one appeals finally and the umpire puts his hand out.
full and outside off,driven to the bowler
outside off stump, goes for the cut and is beaten
tries to jab it to the on side.. hit on the pad

Sathish is run out! It rolled off the pads to the off side ... Sathish wants a single and is sent back .. the fielder rushes in from short cover region and flicks a direct hit with Sathish just short of his crease. Third ump says that's out. Crowd roar!
backs away to cut but can't beat point

pushed towards deep midwicket and they turned for second run. The fielder rushes in from the deep and fired a throw to the bowler who breaks the stumps. Appeal for run out. Third umpire finds that the batsman is home
turned tos quare-leg for a single

How did Vijay catch this?  Here is what happenned. Pollard hits a skier between long-on and long-off. Vijay moves from long-on .. Thushara from long-off ...The ball was falling behind Thushara, who is standing just ahead of Vijay. Thushara gets his hands back, behind him and tries to catch it .. Vijay is distracted as Thushara almost falls on him . Vijay takes his eyes off the ball but manages to hold on to the catch! He just stretched his hands out forward even as he yanked his head away
leans forward to squeeze it through point
around the off stump, tapped close on the off side for a quick single
gets forward to push to short cover
on the middle and leg, worked to short fine-leg
leans forward to drive to long-on
Meanwhile, Tiwary too is gone. He went down on his knee for the slog sweep but hits it tamely to short midwicket. Gone!
quickish arm-ball, tapped to the on side
moves down the track and on drives to long-on
slightly short, pulled to right of deep midwicket
down the leg side, Dhoni gathers
rushes down the track and smashes the full toss well to the right of long-on
on the leg stump line, goes for the slog sweep and the ball rolls of the pad
low dipping full toss, flicked away to square-leg where Hayden makes a diving half-stop
142.9 kmph short of length bouncing delivery, top edged away to third man
short in length on the middle, mistimed back to the bowler
wide outside off stump

Thushara takes a real skier! Bravo went for the lofted hit over long-off .. Thushara came in from the deep and then had to back pedal and he fell on his back as he held on to the catch. His team-mates mob him
low full toss, drilled to long-off
stays back to punch it through the off side
leans forward to push to cover point
Ambati rushes down the track for the lofted hit but Raina pushes it quicker, shorter and it goes on straight outside off and Rayudu swings inside the line..Stumped!
on the leg stump line, tapped to midwicket for a single
driven down to sweeper cover
leans forward to drive to cover
Ambati rocks back to cut it to deep backward point  and they come back for the second run. Slightly wide throw allows Ambati to get int
fullh outside off, driven to short cover
uses his new bat - he has just changed his bat a short while back-  and drives to sweeper cover
low full toss outside off, squeezed out to Tyagi at third man
backs to the leg side, Thushara fires it outside off, left alone
fullish around off, driven to long-off
beamer! No ball! Pushed out to the on side. Harper has a word with the bowler
forced away through the on side for a single
just outside off stump, pushed out to the on side
shortish delivery, pulled away to left of deep midwicket
on the middle and leg, worked to short fine-leg
quickish arm-ball. skids on really quickly, jabbed out to the off side
drives straight to cover
rushes down the track, Jakati pushes it wider outside off stump, Tendulkar lunges across to slice it of the outer edge just over backward point. Almost Mark Waughed.
full in length, around the off stump line, stabbed away to the on side
bouncer on the middle stump line, sails over him
lifting delivery on the off stump line, jabbed out to point
full in length on the middle and leg, eased to long leg
length delivery around off stump, pushed out to cover
full in length outside off stump, pushed out to mid-off
Chopped on! Length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan goes for the cut but perhaps too full for that shot. Thushara screams in joy.
leans forward to push to cover
on the middle and leg, worked to short fine-leg
leans forward to lift it to long-on boundary. One bounce and over the ropes. The crowd love it.
on the off and middle, Tendulkar backs away at the last minute to punch it through cover point
couple of steps down the track and drives to mid-off
leans forward to push it away for a single
full delivery, Tendulkar walks couple of steps and pushes for a risky single to mid-off. It would have got very interesting had it been a direct hit
backs away to the leg side, yorker outside off, Tendulkar tries jab it away but doesn't connect
Top shot. Tendulkar shuffles right across to clip a short-of-length delivery on off and middle through midwicket. He does that often these days.
cuts from the length, moves in to hit the pad and goes away to backward point
short in length, outside off, mistimes the shot to extra cover
hurls a bouncer across, Tendulkar backs away and tries to upper cut it but doesn't connect
really full delivery, pushed back to the bowler
leans forward to drive to right of mid-off
slightly short and outside off, Tendulkar waits for the ball to arrive before cutting it to the point boundary
stays back to punch to extra cover
turns away from the off stump, pushed to point
again slips it down the leg side
leans forward to defend down the pitch
pushes it well down the leg side
charges down the track but mistimes the attempted forcing hit .. the ball rolls to mid-off
full pitched on the middle stump, pushed to mid-off
Dhawan continues to cut under the bounce .. Dhoni collects another short delivery well outside off
good delivery, bounces from a length even as it straightens outside off, Tendulkar squeezes it to third man
banged in short, Tendulkar moves to the off side to pull it to the fine-leg boundary. Almost as if he expected the short one.
length delivery around off, pushed out to extra cover for a single
full in length just outside off stump, run down to third man
short and bouncing outside off, Dhawan, yet again, cuts under the ball ..
full pitched around off stump line, lovely drive through extra cover .. Gorgeously timed
full pitched outside off stump and Dhawan creams it through covers
short and wide, extra bounce, again Dhawan cuts under the ball
short in length, bounces outside off stump, Dhawan goes for the cut and is beaten
fullish outside off stump, hint of swing,, beautifully cover driven
short in length, cut away to wide third man
on the middle stump line, turned to square-leg
full delivery on the middle, eased to midwicket
good delivery curving away from the off stump, left alone
full delivery, mistimes it towards mid-on for a single
